emp-blast-1025.scope: Stock PR1178 verified EMCP Blast 1025 at rest (20 IS, 1 s cast, 30 s reuse): unweakened damage=0 on near dummy only, weakened 6000->1000 at 3 m with 12 m Far Dummy and QAFriend excluded, Close Combat local refusal with 0 IS, and killing blast (1000->0, XP and corpse) after ?cd stop. Production grant owners and item consumption remain open under source-parity.

stealth-detection.source: ability/spy/misc.py DisarmTraps_Test checks directObject.DetectTrapFX before the contest and critically fails with ID_CLIENT_ABILITY_TRAP_DISARM_CRITICAL_FAILURE if the trap is undetected; Detect Traps is a separate unshipped utility.
stealth-detection.runtime: UtilityAbilities.DisarmTrap enforces the DetectTrapFX visibility gate before EvalContest (undetected traps always critically fail and transition to TriggeredState 0x83b).
stealth-detection.test: Stock PR1154 step 1 (?traproll 99, ?trapobj 1416 hidden) logged 'Disarm Traps on 1416 in 0x839: Critical (detected=False, roll=99)' and printed 'Trap went off while being disarmed!', while detected rolls 10/30/50 produced Critical/Failed/Disarmed. Stock PR1173 verified the selected-object disarm and post-disarm InvalidTarget refusal with 0 IS. GeminiLaneClosureTests.DisarmTraps119EnforcesDetectTrapVisibilityGateAndContestThresholds and DisarmTrapsParityTests. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1154#issuecomment-7153160448 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1173#issuecomment-7162583010
